limits: Both native remainder routines execute completely; no dynamic helper is controlled. All finite and infinite-divisor results are checked against exact rational truncated-quotient arithmetic.
Raw NaN payload mismatches, if listed, remain unresolved and are excluded from passed comparison count.
Default MXCSR only. Floating-point exception flags, alternate rounding modes, FTZ/DAZ and full caller/runtime behavior are unverified.

0xb2170.reason: The initial magnitude comparison admits only |x|>|y|. Normalization preserves that ordering. When normalized exponents are equal, the dividend significand must exceed the divisor significand, so the first subtraction cannot be negative. The unconditional jump after that impossible negative branch is unreachable.
